name: motion_cs8_v1
gripper_policy: copy raw greedy gripper into the selected motion action; keep gripper in full-action evaluation
normalization: frozen MultiNet/OpenVLA q01/q99 mapping, constant dimensions zero; no test fitting
bandwidth: median positive pairwise Euclidean distance + 1e-6; fallback 1+1e-6
sampling_policy: fixed T=1/top-k=10/N=8, no parameter selection on these episodes
invalid_token_policy: abort on tokens outside the 256 action-token vocabulary; accept legal upper edge
scope: Jaco test episode IDs 20..59, disjoint from the CS development pilot IDs 0..19; baseline aggregate previously inspected
